title: Reality of Prayer: Reverence, Reliance, Oneness, and the End of the Believers

questions.question: What words did the believers say when they saw Allah’s greatness and beauty shown in creation?
questions.answer: They said that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: What did they do with their bodies after saying those words?
questions.answer: They bowed and made sujood with humility.

questions.question: What feelings did they show when they bowed and made sujood?
questions.answer: They showed love, wonder, and humility.

questions.question: Why did they ask Allah for help?
questions.answer: They knew they were needy and poor before Allah.

questions.question: What words did they say to ask for help?
questions.answer: They said that they seek help from Allah alone.

questions.question: When they saw the amazing things Allah made, what did they say about them?
questions.answer: They said Allah willed these wonders.

questions.question: How did they react to the beauty of Allah’s creation?
questions.answer: They admired it and spoke well of it.

questions.question: What did they say to show that Allah gave blessings?
questions.answer: They said that Allah gave blessings.

questions.question: What did they say to show faith?
questions.answer: They said that they truly believe.

questions.question: What call did they give to other people after seeing these signs?
questions.answer: They called people to come, look, pray, and seek success.

questions.question: How did they answer Allah’s rule over everything?
questions.answer: They answered with submission and obedience.

questions.question: What sentence showed that they accepted Allah’s command?
questions.answer: They said that they hear and obey.

questions.question: What important truth did they confirm about Allah?
questions.answer: They confirmed that Allah is One.

questions.question: How did they worship before the Lord of all worlds?
questions.answer: They worshipped with humility, prayer, and respect.

questions.question: What are the prescribed prayers called in the passage?
questions.answer: They are called a summary of worship.

questions.question: Where did they carry out their worship and life duties?
questions.answer: They did them in this world, which is described like a great mosque.

questions.question: What high place did they reach after doing their duties?
questions.answer: They rose above the other creatures to a very high rank.

questions.question: What made them trustworthy caretakers on earth?
questions.answer: Belief, certainty, and the Trust made them that way.

questions.question: What did Allah invite them to after the test of this life?
questions.answer: He invited them to everlasting happiness and the home of peace.

questions.question: What are the rewards there like?
questions.answer: They are blessings beyond what people have seen, heard, or even imagined.

questions.question: Why will those who love the everlasting beauty not be lost?
questions.answer: Because they will go on to eternal life.

questions.question: What final prayer is made at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: A prayer that Allah includes us among those blessed people.

questions.question: What did the believers say when they saw signs of Allah’s beauty, greatness, and perfection in the world?
questions.answer: They said that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: What two actions showed their respect after that?
questions.answer: They bowed and made sujood.

questions.question: The passage says they knew their poverty and need. What did that make them do?
questions.answer: It made them beg Allah and ask Him for help.

questions.question: Whom did they ask for help from?
questions.answer: From Allah alone.

questions.question: What did they notice in the created world that made them speak with admiration?
questions.answer: They noticed the fine details and wonders in Allah’s creation.

questions.question: What did they say to show that these wonders happened by Allah’s will?
questions.answer: They said that Allah willed them.

questions.question: What simple idea is shown by their words about beauty and blessings in creation?
questions.answer: They saw creation as beautiful and full of blessings from Allah.

questions.question: What did they say to make their belief clear?
questions.answer: They said that they believe.

questions.question: Did they keep this truth to themselves, or did they invite others too?
questions.answer: They invited others too.

questions.question: What did they invite others to do?
questions.answer: To come, look, pray, and seek success.

questions.question: How did they answer the Lord’s rule and power over the universe?
questions.answer: They answered with obedience and submission.

questions.question: What words showed that obedience?
questions.answer: They said that they hear and obey.

questions.question: What teaching about Allah is connected to that obedience?
questions.answer: It is connected to affirming Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What kind of worship did they offer before the Lord of all the worlds?
questions.answer: They offered humble worship and respectful prayer.

questions.question: What did their prayers help gather together?
questions.answer: Their prayers gathered together the meaning of worship.

questions.question: In what place did they do their many duties?
questions.answer: In this world, described as a huge mosque.

questions.question: What happened to them because of their worship and belief?
questions.answer: They fulfilled their life duties and reached a noble level.

questions.question: What special job on earth were they given?
questions.answer: They became trustworthy vicegerents, or caretakers, on earth.

questions.question: After life’s test ended, what did their Lord offer them?
questions.answer: Eternal happiness and the Abode of Peace.

questions.question: How amazing are the blessings waiting for them there?
questions.answer: They are greater than anything people have seen, heard, or imagined.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the people who love the everlasting beauty of Allah?
